Jordan Miller: Quick Q — can managers submit a mid-cycle comp / leveling exception for an IC we want to move to L5? what's the deadline and payroll impact?
Emily (People Ops): Yes — you can. Short checklist: comp-change form, updated role profile, manager justification (specific examples of impact), 2 peer/skip-level notes if available, and a suggested comp target. Deadlines matter for payroll.
Jordan Miller: thanks — is there a single place to upload docs? and who signs off?
Emily (People Ops): Upload to the comp-change folder on Drive: https://drive.redwood /Shared/PeopleOps/comp-changes (link shortened in channel). Approvals: first manager -> skip-level -> People Ops review -> Comp Committee. Comp Committee meets weekly on Tuesdays.
Alexa Chen: for timelines, if we submit by the deadline, does the increase hit the next payroll or the one after?
Emily (People Ops): If approved before the payroll cutoff (Mon 11:59pm PT the week before payroll), change can be effective on the requested effective date and payroll will include backpay if the effective date is in the prior pay period. If approved after cutoff, change typically goes into the following payroll. So aim to submit at least 5 business days before your target effective date.
Matt R: any guidance re: salary bands and managers pushing above midpoint? do we need exec sign-off for exceptions > band midpoint?
Emily (People Ops): Use the band table in the Drive doc. Exceptions above midpoint require a comp-impact note + justification of market or retention risk. Anything > band max needs VP-level approval and will go to Exec Comp Review. Examples that often pass: counteroffers, retention-critical hires, exceptional promotion cases with documented impact.
Jordan Miller: good to know. Is there a template for the manager justification?
Emily (People Ops): Yep — there's a short template in the Drive folder: include: 1) business impact (quantified if possible), 2) stretch examples vs peers, 3) retention risk, 4) suggested new comp and proposed effective date. Paste the template into the form field or attach a doc.
comp-bot: Reminder: new comp-change form created by Jordan Miller, draft saved. Use `/hr submit-comp-change` to start.
Jordan Miller: perfect — one last: communications post-approval? who emails the IC?
Emily (People Ops): Manager leads the conversation. People Ops will draft an approval note for you with talking points and official comp paperwork (offer letter addendum if needed). We handle payroll/finance notifications.
Alexa Chen: tagging for visibility @Emily — do managers need to confirm budget owners?
Emily (People Ops): Yes, include the cost center and budget owner in the form so Finance can sign off. If it's cross-team you'll need both owners' acknowledgement.
Jordan Miller: thanks — I'll fill the form and ping here when submitted. :thumbsup:
Emily (People Ops): Thanks! Ping us in this channel or DM if you need help filling the form. :white_check_mark:
